sources.quote: Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-220 is on PRG-X (Aurelia). Moving from clear anodising (COAT-ANOD) to a trivalent conversion coating (COAT-TCP) is a coating change. Aurelia Supplier Quality Manual rev 4 replaces rev 3 and now requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping, plus 90 days' notice. Rev 3 only required 60 days' notice. No approval or notification in the documents covers this change.
